 Joel Embiid (foot) off injury report Monday 
 by Chris Schommer | 76ers Correspondent | Mon, Nov 16th 2026, 7:12pm EST 
 Joel Embiid (foot) is off of the injury report for the Philadelphia 76ers against the Brooklyn Nets Monday night. ( Adam Aaronson on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Embiid will take the floor after previously carrying a questionable designation earlier Monday, boosting a Philadelphia starting five they will rest LeBron James in the second leg of the back-to-back Monday night.
 Joel Embiid is officially AVAILABLE for Sixers-Nets tonight.
Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, Dean Wade start alongside him.
— Adam Aaronson (@SixersAdam) November 17, 2026
